shots.description: The small tan dragon, Scales, balances on a wooden beam.
A young woman with short red hair is visible.
The small tan dragon, Scales, perches on a wooden beam, watching birds fly across the sky.
A young woman with short red hair runs up stone steps.
A young woman with short red hair looks down at a ruined town.
A young woman with short red hair runs across a ruined stone fortress at sunset as red-winged creatures fly overhead.
A young woman with short red hair stands on a rocky ledge, shielding her eyes from the setting sun.
A young woman with short red hair runs across rooftops at sunset.
A young woman with short red hair stands before a brick ruin at sunset, her hands clasped, then raised, then mouth open in surprise.
A young woman with short red hair smiles.
A young woman with short red hair looks up as dragons fly past at sunset.
The small tan dragon, Scales, flies near a huge tan-brown dragon.
The small tan dragon, Scales, soars through pink clouds toward a ruined town where a young woman stands.
A young woman with short red hair reaches toward a small tan dragon flying away at sunset.
A young woman with short red hair stares wide-eyed, mouth open, against a dusky sky.
The small tan dragon, Scales, flies toward a reaching hand.
A young woman with short red hair gasps as a creature lifts her into the air.
A young woman with red hair lies prone as a huge dragon looms overhead, then leaps away over broken stone under a dusky sky.
A huge dragon soars over ruins at sunset.
A young woman with short red hair stands amid ruins, eyes wide, mouth open.
A young woman with short red hair stands on a ruined rooftop at sunset, watching a creature fly toward a distant tower.
The red-haired young woman, Sintel, runs across a massive root bridge in a dark cave.
The red-haired young woman, Sintel, leaps down a dark cave with her staff.
The red-haired young woman, Sintel, walks toward a small pale dragon curled up asleep in the dark cave.
The red-haired young woman, Sintel, crouches in dim cave light.
The small pale dragon stirs, opens its eyes, and lifts its head.
The red-haired young woman, Sintel, stares wide-eyed in dim cave.
Sintel stabs the dragon. Fire erupts from its chest. She walks toward the cave mouth.
The red-haired young woman, Sintel, climbs a dark cave wall, gripping a sword.
The small tan dragon, Scales, walks across the cave floor.

The red-haired young woman, Sintel, touches glowing crystals on a cave wall. She turns, wielding a large blade. A huge dark grey dragon lunges. She dodges, swings her blade at its wing. The dragon rears back, roaring.
The red-haired young woman, Sintel, stands on a rocky slope, gazing at distant snow-capped mountains under a hazy sky.
Sintel walks away from the camera toward the misty mountains, white flowers nearby.
Sintel continues walking away, her figure shrinking against the vast, hazy mountains, white flowers nearby.
The small tan dragon, Scales, lies on the rocky ground, its wing bleeding, as Sintel walks farther away.
Scales lies still on the rocky ground as Sintel walks farther away into the hazy distance.
